---
title: "Per-slide options"
format:
  emiljs:
    keep-emiljs: true
_quarto:
  tests:
    emiljs:
      noErrors: []
      ensureHtmlElements:
        - ['section.slide#s1[data-variant="title"]', 'section.slide#s2']
        - ['section.slide#s2[data-variant]']
      ensureEmiljsFileRegexMatches:
        # the options block becomes the slide's own frontmatter, ahead of its content
        - ['\n---\nvariant: title\n---\n\n# First', '\n\*\*\*\n\nSecond']
        # one that is not the first block of its slide is dropped, not emitted
        - ['not-a-key']
      printsMessage:
        level: INFO
        regex: 'must be the first block of its slide'
---

```{.yaml .slide}
variant: title
```

# First

***

Second

```{.yaml .slide}
not-a-key: 1
```
